headline: Iran threatens to close more vital seaways as US renews blockade
body_text: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) warned that "Regional energy exports are either shared by all, or denied to all," threatening closure of additional export corridors benefiting the US and its allies. The corridors named are the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb (the Red Sea gateway). War between the US/Israel and Iran began February 28 with US and Israeli strikes against Iran; a tentative truce was signed in June; escalation resumed the week before publication (article published 2026-07-15/16). The US reimposed a naval blockade of Iranian ports and launched military strikes. The IRGC accused the US of dispatching "naval pirates to the Indian Ocean" to control the Strait of Hormuz. The IRGC stated it struck US military sites in Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan. The conflict has severely disrupted global energy supplies and raised inflation concerns. The apparent threat to Bab el-Mandeb shipping represents the next regional flashpoint. Trump warned of targeting Iranian energy infrastructure.
